sections.title: Engraving that *lasts a lifetime*

image.alt: A laser engraver at work over a sheet of plywood

body: Deep etch for bold, permanent marks; laser for sleek, detailed precision. We engrave metal, glass, acrylic and wood, from plaques and trophies to signs and personal gifts.

Our firearm engraving meets NFA Trust and ATF requirements, on AR-style lowers, rifles, shotguns and handguns, with names, initials, logos or artwork. Most jobs are done the same day, often while you wait; for bigger custom work we’ll give you a clear timeline first.
list: Free engraving on products bought through us

sections.title: From a backyard shed *to Trolley Line Road*

image.alt: Founder Barry Johnson beside the gas pumps of an early shop, in a faded vintage photo

body: Barry H. Johnson started Trophies Unlimited in 1977 in his father’s shed in the backyard. He bought his first real shop, a converted gas station, and in 1980 bought T-Bo’s convenience store, which is still our home today.

Barry’s son Mike grew up in Aiken and graduated from Aiken High in 1992. After Barry passed away in 2003, Mike came home, and in 2010 he took over as CEO, or as he puts it, “The Fixer.” He runs the shop alongside his mother, carrying on the family tradition.
list: Run by Mike Johnson and his mother

items.q: What types of engraving do you offer?
items.a: Firearm engraving, including NFA Trust and ATF-compliant engraving on AR-style lowers, rifles, shotguns and handguns, plus custom designs, deep etch and laser engraving for plaques, trophies, signs and gifts.

items.q: Do you offer same-day firearm engraving?
items.a: Yes. In most cases it’s done the same day, often while you wait. For larger or highly custom projects we’ll give you a clear timeline before we start.

items.q: What can I bring in for engraving?
items.a: Metal, glass, acrylic and wood: trophies, plaques, gifts and firearms.

items.q: Can I order trophies or plaques in bulk?
items.a: Yes. We handle bulk and custom orders for schools, businesses and organizations, consistent and on time.

items.q: Do you ship, or is it pickup only?
items.a: Local pickup at our Aiken showroom, and shipping may be available for some products. Call us to talk through your order.

sections.text: Call or stop by Monday to Friday, 9:30 to 5:30.
